budget_visibility.basis: The registered worker passes no --model-profile; the solve adapter reuses controller.runtime. An absent profile resolves to no native UsageLedger, and _budget_messages returns unchanged messages in that branch. The separate campaign accounting guard remains active.

code_references.purpose: Fixed solve argv includes max_steps and no model profile.
Final runtime result requires a model turn without tool calls and nonempty text.
Whole tool batch admission enforces the tool-call limit.
No native ledger means no runtime budget advisory.
No model profile resolves to no native usage ledger.
Absent model-profile argument produces profile=None on controller runtime.
Runtime failure maps to worker_failed before candidate draft parsing at line357.
Initial population generation failure becomes candidate_failed.
Offspring generation failure records candidate_failed without persistence.
A batch with zero evaluated candidates terminates as offspring_batch_failed.
Bundle persistence allocates run roots and records execution evidence only after a draft is returned.
Parent task handoff is settled before the child evolution runs.
Failed evolution child overrides effective CLI status.

generation_boundary.reason: The runtime rejects the whole returned tool batch when executed calls plus batch size exceeds max_steps; it does not return the final Agent result.

limitations: This identifies the immediate stop boundary for three generation invocations within one campaign attempt; it is not evidence of a candidate JSON parse, execution, evaluator, or delivery defect.
The remaining unexecuted tool names and eventual candidate correctness are not inferred from partial tool activity.
Absent budget guidance is a confirmed product visibility gap; this observation does not prove it caused the model behavior.
No larger step limit, revised prompt, or budget advisory was tested; none is claimed to guarantee a successful future attempt.
The failed campaign remains one independent outcome and is not resumed, replaced, or relabeled.
status_explanation: The native handoff supersedes parent pending tasks and settles the parent before running its evolution child. The child failure changes effective CLI status; it does not rewrite the settled parent status. Delivery requires child success.

suggested_next_sdd_scope.measurement: Any different max_steps value or changed product requires a separately specified and registered new acceptance attempt; this campaign stays closed.
suggested_next_sdd_scope.product: Expose bounded remaining tool-call and time guidance for unprofiled Agent loops, preserving individual-call counting and whole-batch admission semantics.
suggested_next_sdd_scope.separate_followup: Consider safe typed candidate-generation failure projection so CLI users can distinguish tool-step exhaustion from candidate execution failures.
suggested_next_sdd_scope.verification: Use deterministic synthetic model turns to verify request-copy-only advisory updates, unchanged transcripts, unchanged failure boundaries, no automatic extra request, and unchanged profiled accounting.
